ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is at the top of the food web?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of a soil food web. On the left side there are sources such as plants, algae, bacteria, lichens, organic matter, and dead matter; in the middle there are fungi, bacteria, and various feeders; on the right side there are higher-level consumers such as predatory nematodes and predatory mites. In the lower right there is a box labeled “High level Predators”. Reasoning: Following the arrows of the food web from basic substances and lower-level consumers toward higher predatory levels, the highest trophic-level category ultimately pointed to is the box labeled “High level Predators”. Therefore, at the top of the food web are high-level predators.
